description: Four-character NEON site identifier.
Gas or storage-flux target represented by the row.
notes: CO2 storage_flux is FC_stor_interp; H2O storage_flux is LE_stor_interp; CH4 storage_flux is computed.

description: Primary 30-minute timestamp used for joins and plotting.
notes: CSV timestamps are written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS in UTC. The Aug 2021-Jun 2024 release holds half-hours before 2024-07-01 00:00 UTC and the Jul 2024-Aug 2026 release the rest; each comes from its own run of the same code.

description: Timestamp label used by the storage output. For computed CH4 this labels the interval start.
Beginning timestamp of the storage calculation interval or source interval.
Ending timestamp of the storage calculation interval or source interval.
Interval-end timestamp retained for storage terms whose primary label is interval start.
Mean atmospheric pressure used for profile density correction when available.
Mean air temperature used for profile density correction when available.
Mean relative humidity used to estimate water vapor pressure when available.
Water vapor pressure estimated from RH and saturation vapor pressure.
notes: Derived from RH and air temperature.

description: Dry-air molar density calculated as (P - e) / (R * T).
notes: Uses water-vapor pressure correction.

description: Dry-air gas concentration used in storage calculation.
notes: Gas-specific concentration scale: CO2 umol m-3, H2O mmol m-3, CH4 umol m-3.

description: Standard uncertainty of dry-air gas concentration propagated from input variance and sample count.
notes: Computed from input vari_A/B and numSamp_A/B where available.

description: Units for dry_air_concentration and dry_air_concentration_uncertainty.
Applied time synchronization offset relative to original timeMid.
notes: Includes gas offset and tube-time correction where available.

description: Source of time synchronization information.
Tube transit-time correction from site tower metadata where available.
Source or availability flag for TimeTube_s.
Lowest tower-profile measurement height used for storage context.
Highest tower-profile measurement height used for storage context.
Tower-column height used for storage integration context.
Total number of tower levels in site metadata.
Number of tower levels contributing valid gas concentration or rate information at the half-hour.
Number of tower levels with valid dry-air molar density information at the half-hour.
Largest temporal interpolation gap among tower levels for the half-hour.
Number of vertical grid cells used in the eddy4R-style spatial interpolation.
notes: Applies only to computed profile-based storage; pulled storage rows may be NA.

description: Storage quality flag. One indicates the raw storage estimate should not be used directly.
Reason for storage_qf value.
Vertically integrated column burden. Currently retained for compatibility and may be NA.
notes: Currently not populated in the output.

description: Units for column_burden.
Time step used for storage-rate calculation.
notes: Typically 1800 s.

description: Column-rate storage flux from the raw calculation or pulled source when directly comparable.
notes: For H2O pulled as latent heat storage, this may be NA because units are W m-2.

description: Raw storage flux value before gapfilling. CO2 and H2O may be pulled directly from NEON aligned storage columns; CH4 is computed.
notes: Use storage_flux_filled for continuous downstream calculations.

description: Standard uncertainty for storage_flux where available.
Units for storage_flux_uncertainty.
Method used to estimate storage_flux_uncertainty.
Number of source storage values aggregated into a half-hour for pulled NEON storage terms.
notes: Mostly populated for pulled CO2/H2O storage rows.

description: Sign-flipped storage_flux helper for AmeriFlux-style storage comparisons for CO2 and CH4.
notes: Use only for AmeriFlux comparison; not for NEON-native totals.

description: Units for storage_flux and storage_flux_column_rate.
notes: CO2 umol m-2 s-1; H2O W m-2 for pulled LE storage; CH4 umol m-2 s-1. CH4 values are umol m-2 s-1; labels in the source runs said nmol and were corrected when the release files were written (values unchanged).

description: Original aligned-file column used as the source storage term, when storage was pulled rather than computed.
notes: FC_stor_interp for CO2; LE_stor_interp for H2O; NA for computed CH4.

description: Human-readable description of whether storage was pulled from NEON aligned output or computed from profiles.
Storage framework or compatibility implementation used by the script.
Storage calculation method summary.
Time synchronization method summary.
Time interpolation method summary.
Rate calculation method summary.
Vertical interpolation and integration method summary.
Minimum number of valid tower levels required before raw computed storage is accepted.
Path or description of tower metadata source used to determine tower levels and heights.
Dry-air molar density calculation method.
Description of dry-air density correction.
Sign convention note for storage_flux and storage_flux_ameriflux_sign.
notes: NEON-native convention adds storage to turbulent flux.

description: Timestamp convention note for storage_flux.
TRUE when the row was inserted only to complete the 30-minute time grid.
notes: Inserted rows allow every missing half-hour to appear explicitly in the CSV.

description: Gapfilled continuous storage-flux series. This is the preferred complete series for downstream use.
notes: Gapfill order: short linear interpolation, +/-30 day diurnal median, diurnal climatology, site/gas median. Gap filling was run separately for Aug 2021-Jun 2024 and Jul 2024-Aug 2026, so climatologies and site/gas medians come from the release period of each file.

description: Uncertainty assigned to storage_flux_filled, inherited or gapfill-derived.
TRUE when storage_flux_filled replaces a missing raw storage_flux value.
Method used to fill storage_flux_filled.
Number of donor observations used by the gapfill method.
Sign-flipped helper for storage_flux_filled for AmeriFlux-style comparisons for CO2 and CH4.
notes: Use only for AmeriFlux comparison; not for NEON-native totals.
